body.title: Implement the daemon verifier (test-run + working-tree diff → BuildTestVerdict + filesTouched) behind an injectable seam
body.summary: Extract the self-contained daemon-side verifier that the sequencer and both test Tasks assume as an injectable 'fake daemon test-run+diff hook'. It takes the stated test command verbatim from a PlanTask, runs it as a subprocess, captures exit code + summary into BuildTestVerdict ({ command, passed, exitCode, summary }), and takes the git working-tree diff to compute filesTouched — the daemon's OWN authority for a reached outcome, computed independently of the advisory report. Exposes a single narrow interface (the seam t8/t9 stub) and handles the empty/absent stated test command case explicitly (no command → not a passing verdict). Real subprocess/git mechanics live here, not inside sequencer guts (split out of the former t5 L per s3 critique; invariants c1).
acceptanceChecks: The verifier is a self-contained module exposing a single injectable interface that, given a PlanTask and repoRoot, extracts the stated test command verbatim, runs it, and returns BuildTestVerdict + filesTouched computed from the git working-tree diff — the same seam t8/t9 fake instead of reaching a real provider/git.

An empty or absent stated test command yields a non-passing verdict (never a fabricated 'passed'), and filesTouched reflects only the actual working-tree diff; the verdict is computed with no reference to any TaskImplementerReport.

tests.name: verifier: given a PlanTask + repoRoot the injectable verifier extracts the stated test command verbatim, returns BuildTestVerdict + filesTouched from the working-tree diff, and yields a non-passing verdict (never a fabricated 'passed') for an empty/absent command
